n13076b485d.headline: The company engaged in mask production received a concession; 35 new jobs will be created
n13076b485d.summary: A company engaged in mask production in Armenia received a concession and plans to import goods worth over 242 million drams while creating 35 new jobs.
n13076b485d.why: Mask production is critical amid the pandemic, and job creation supports local employment and supply chain development in Armenia.
